facets.hintZh: 纯 CSS，还是要写 JS / 用浏览器 API
facets.hintEn: Pure CSS, or needs JS and browser APIs
Who is left out, and the fix

facets.hintZh: 能不能直接用，还是得先查兼容表
facets.hintEn: Safe to ship, or check the compatibility table first

demoShapes.hintZh: 默认：居中舞台就装得下
demoShapes.hintEn: Default: a centered stage is enough

demoShapes.hintZh: 要在大范围里移动指针或拖动，小舞台做不出来
demoShapes.hintEn: Needs pointer movement or dragging over a large area

demoShapes.hintZh: 自带滚动容器，不依赖整页滚动
demoShapes.hintEn: Ships its own scroll container — never the page scroll

demoShapes.hintZh: 多阶段状态，要一步步推进才看得懂
demoShapes.hintEn: Multi-stage states that need stepping through

demoShapes.hintZh: 需要两块「页面」才演示得出来

entries.oneLiner: 一组元素不是同时出现，而是按顺序一个接一个进来。
entries.oneLinerEn: A group of elements enters one after another on a fixed interval, not all at once.

prompt.zh: 给这组列表项做交错进场（stagger）动画：每项从下方 16px、opacity 0 进入最终位置，单项时长 420ms，缓动 cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)，相邻两项间隔 80ms。只在首次出现时播放一次，用 transform 和 opacity 实现。系统开启「减少动态效果」时直接显示最终状态。
prompt.en: staggered entrance, animation-delay: index * 80ms, each item fades in with opacity 0 → 1 and translateY(16px) → 0, duration 420ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), play once on first view, animate transform/opacity only, respect prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 决定动画快慢怎么分配：起步快还是收尾慢，全在这条曲线上。
entries.oneLinerEn: How an animation spends its time: fast off the line or soft on arrival, all in one curve.

prompt.zh: 帮我调一下动效的缓动曲线：入场用 cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)，动画时长 900ms，每轮结束后停 300ms。位移幅度大概 100% 的可用宽度，用 transform 走，不要动 left/top。同一批元素（按钮、卡片）必须用同一条曲线，手感才统一；缓动只改时间分配，不要顺手把路径也改了。
prompt.en: animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transition-timing-function, cubic-bezier() easing curve, duration 900ms, delay 300ms, travel 100%, animate transform only (no left/top), keep one shared easing across buttons and cards, respect prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 元素像挂了弹簧一样冲向目标：可能冲过头，再弹回来停住。
entries.oneLinerEn: An element driven at its target like it is on a spring, overshooting and settling back.

prompt.zh: 给这个元素做弹簧动画（spring physics）：用 stiffness 260、damping 18、mass 1 三个参数驱动，目标位置是右侧终点，允许轻微超调但不能晃超过两下，300ms 内停稳。只动 transform，用 requestAnimationFrame 或动画库的 spring 实现，不要每帧改 width/height。prefers-reduced-motion 下直接落到终点。
prompt.en: spring animation, stiffness 260, damping 18, mass 1, overshoot allowed but settle within ~300ms, animate transform: translateX only, driven by requestAnimationFrame or a spring library (Framer Motion / react-spring), no layout-thrashing properties, respect prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 内容滚进视口时才淡入上移，没滚到的先藏着。
entries.oneLinerEn: Content fades in and slides up only once it scrolls into view; off-screen items stay hidden.

prompt.zh: 给这些内容块加滚动揭示（reveal on scroll）：用 IntersectionObserver 监听，threshold 0.2，元素露出后播放 opacity 0 → 1、translateY(24px) → 0 的过渡，时长 550ms、cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)，相邻块错开 60ms，播完立刻 unobserve。只动 transform 和 opacity。prefers-reduced-motion 下不要观察，内容直接显示。
prompt.en: reveal on scroll, IntersectionObserver with threshold 0.2, add class when isIntersecting, transition: opacity 550ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform translateY(24px) to 0, stagger 60ms, unobserve after first intersection, opacity + transform only, respect prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 滚动时前景和后景走不同速度，画面因此有了纵深。
entries.oneLinerEn: Foreground and background move at different speeds as you scroll, which gives the scene depth.

prompt.zh: 给这个滚动容器做视差滚动（parallax）：背景层按滚动距离乘 0.45 偏移，中景和前景各按不同系数偏移，基准位移 60px。用 transform: translate3d 实现，scroll 里用 requestAnimationFrame 节流，只在滚动期间加 will-change: transform。prefers-reduced-motion 下把系数归零。
prompt.en: parallax scrolling, multi-layer scroll depth, each layer translate3d(0, scrollY * 0.45 + 60px, 0), background slower than foreground, driven by requestAnimationFrame inside a passive scroll listener, will-change: transform only while scrolling, respect prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 滚动条就是进度条：滚到哪一帧由滚动位置决定。
entries.oneLinerEn: The scrollbar is the timeline: the scroll position decides exactly which frame is shown.

prompt.zh: 用 CSS 滚动驱动动画（scroll-driven animations）做这个效果：卡片用 animation-timeline: view()、animation-range: entry 0% cover 60%，把滚动进度映射到 rotateZ(30deg) 和 opacity 上；顶部进度条用 animation-timeline: scroll() 配 transform: scaleX()。滚动事件里不要写 JS。Safari / Firefox 不支持时，用 intersection 触发一段 600ms 的普通动画兜底，并给出「不支持」的提示。
prompt.en: scroll-driven animations, animation-timeline: view(), animation-range: entry 0% cover 60%, keyframes on rotateZ(30deg) and opacity, scroll progress bar via animation-timeline: scroll() with transform: scaleX(), no scroll event listeners, feature-detect with CSS.supports('animation-timeline: scroll()'), fallback to a 600ms reveal with IntersectionObserver, respect prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 指针移到卡片上，它轻轻上浮、阴影变大，暗示这块可以点。
entries.oneLinerEn: When the pointer moves onto a card, it rises slightly and the shadow deepens, hinting that it is clickable.

prompt.zh: 给卡片加悬停抬升（hover lift）：指针移上去时用 transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.02) 抬起，阴影加深到约 45% 的强度（如 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.10)），过渡 200ms、缓动 cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)；指针移开立刻回到原位。位移只用 transform，不要改 top 或 margin。触摸设备没有 hover，静止态必须完整可读。
prompt.en: hover lift micro-interaction, :hover { transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.10); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) }, transform-only, no top/margin, reset on pointer leave, touch devices keep a static readable state

entries.oneLiner: 手指按下的瞬间按钮缩小、变暗，松开立刻弹回，确认这一下点到了。
entries.oneLinerEn: The moment a finger presses down the button shrinks and darkens, then snaps back on release to confirm the tap.

prompt.zh: 给按钮加按压反馈（press feedback）：按住时用 transform: scale(0.96) 缩小，过渡 110ms；松开回到 scale(1)，缓动 cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)。回弹可以轻微过冲，但别超过 1.0 太多。按下用 :active 或 pointerdown，同时给键盘用户保留 :focus-visible 描边。按钮不能因此改变尺寸。
prompt.en: button press feedback, :active { transform: scale(0.96); transition: transform 110ms }, release back to scale(1) with cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), slight overshoot spring, transform-only, keep :focus-visible ring, touch-action: manipulation

entries.oneLiner: 指针靠近时按钮被吸过去一点点，移开又弹回原位。
entries.oneLinerEn: The button drifts a little toward the pointer as it approaches, then springs back to its resting spot.

prompt.zh: 做一个磁吸按钮（magnetic button）：监听容器的 pointermove，用 getBoundingClientRect 算出按钮中心，指针进入按钮宽高 1.6 倍范围内时，让按钮朝指针方向偏移，偏移量 = 指针到中心的距离 × 0.30，并限制在 12px 以内；指针离开就复位，复位过渡 350ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)。用 transform: translate3d 移动，pointermove 里用 requestAnimationFrame 节流。系统减少动态效果时完全不跟随。
prompt.en: magnetic button, pointermove + getBoundingClientRect, offset = (pointer - center) * 0.30, clamp to 12px, activation radius 1.6x button size, return with transition 350ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform: translate3d, throttle with requestAnimationFrame, disable under prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 灰色占位块上有一道亮光反复扫过，表示内容还在加载。
entries.oneLinerEn: A grey placeholder block with a light band sweeping across it, showing that the content is still loading.

prompt.zh: 做一个骨架屏微光（skeleton shimmer）：按最终布局摆好占位块，灰色底用 color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 12%, transparent)。再加一层覆盖的 linear-gradient 高光带，宽度约 32%，用 transform: translateX 从 -100% 平移到 100%，1400ms linear infinite 循环，不要动 width 或 background-position。头像圆加 3 行文本占位。系统减少动态效果时去掉扫光，只留静态占位。
prompt.en: skeleton screen with shimmer, placeholder blocks at currentColor 8-12%, overlay linear-gradient highlight band 32% wide, @keyframes shimmer { from { transform: translateX(-100%) } to { transform: translateX(100%) } }, 1400ms linear infinite, 3 text rows + avatar circle, animate transform only (never width/background-position), static under prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 点下去界面立刻变成成功的样子，请求在后台跑，失败了再退回去。
entries.oneLinerEn: The UI flips to the success state the moment you click, while the request runs and rolls back on failure.

prompt.zh: 做一个乐观更新（optimistic UI）的点赞列表：点击后立刻把这一条改成已赞、计数 +1，同时标记 pending，不等接口返回。模拟请求延迟 1200ms，失败概率 30%，失败时按 id 回滚到原状态并在那一条上显示「失败，已撤销」的提示。用 useOptimistic 或本地 state 实现，注意快速连点的竞态。
prompt.en: optimistic UI like button, update state immediately on click and mark pending, no await, simulated latency 1200ms, failure rate 30%, rollback by id on error with an inline error message, handle race conditions (last write wins), useOptimistic, aria-live polite for the error

entries.oneLiner: 一条短消息从屏幕边缘滑进来，几秒后自己消失，不打断当前操作。
entries.oneLinerEn: A short message slides in from the screen edge and dismisses itself after a few seconds, without blocking.

prompt.zh: 做一个轻提示（toast）组件：触发后从底部居中滑入，滑入距离 12px，入场 220ms ease-out，停留 3000ms 后自动消失。容器用 role="status" 和 aria-live="polite"，多条时纵向堆叠、最多同时 3 条。动画只用 transform: translateY 和 opacity，禁用状态别遮挡页面操作。系统减少动态效果时直接出现和消失。
prompt.en: toast / snackbar component, slides in from 底部居中, translateY(12px) with 220ms ease-out, auto-dismiss after 3000ms, role="status" aria-live="polite", stack up to 3 toasts, animate transform + opacity only, non-blocking, no entry/exit animation under prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 页面滚动时头部留在顶部，常配合「下滑隐藏、上滑出现」。
entries.oneLinerEn: A page header that stays pinned on scroll and often hides on the way down.

prompt.zh: 做粘性头部（sticky header）：用 position: sticky; top: 0 吸顶，滚动超过 60px 后给头部加半透明底色和 backdrop-filter: blur(8px) 与一条下边框。向下滚动时用 transform: translateY(-100%) 收起头部，向上滚动立刻显示，判定用当前 scrollY 与上一次 scrollY 比较，动画 250ms ease-out。
prompt.en: sticky header, position: sticky; top: 0, add backdrop-filter: blur(8px) and border-bottom after 60px scroll, hide on scroll down / reveal on scroll up via transform: translateY(-100%) with 250ms ease-out, compare current vs previous scrollY, animate transform only, throttle scroll handler with requestAnimationFrame

entries.oneLiner: 滚动时后面的卡片一张张压上来，前一张缩小留在底下。
entries.oneLinerEn: Cards scroll up one by one and stack on top of each other as the earlier ones shrink behind.

prompt.zh: 做一组滚动堆叠卡片（sticky stacking cards）：共 6 张，每张用 position: sticky，top 依次是「索引 × 18px」，后面的卡片 z-index 更高、滚上来时盖住前一张；被压住的卡片用 transform: scale() 缩到 95%，transform-origin 设 top center，圆角 14px。整组放在一个 overflow-y: auto 的容器里，容器外面的祖先不要加 overflow: hidden。系统开启「减少动态效果」时取消缩放。
prompt.en: sticky stacking cards, position: sticky with top: index * 18px, 6 cards, increasing z-index 1 2 3, previous card scales down to 95% via transform: scale() with transform-origin: top center, border-radius: 14px, inside an overflow-y: auto scroll container, no overflow: hidden on ancestors, disable the scale under prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 卡片高度不齐，自动落进最短的那一列，底部不留大洞。
entries.oneLinerEn: Cards of uneven height drop into the shortest column, so no large gaps open at the bottom.

prompt.zh: 做一个瀑布流（masonry）列表：3 列，列间距 10px，条目高度围绕 64px 参差排布，每个条目加 break-inside: avoid，别让卡片被从中间劈开跨列；顺序按列从上往下填，窄屏自动降到 2 列。不要用固定高度把每格拉齐，那就不是瀑布流了。
prompt.en: masonry layout, CSS multi-column with column-count: 3, column-gap: 10px, items of varying height around 64px with break-inside: avoid, fill columns top-to-bottom, collapse to 2 columns on narrow screens, do not equalize item heights

entries.oneLiner: 大小不一的方块拼成一整块，边线对齐，主次一眼分得清。
entries.oneLinerEn: Tiles of different sizes lock into one block with aligned edges, so the hierarchy reads at a glance.

prompt.zh: 做一个 Bento 网格首页：CSS grid，4 列，grid-auto-rows: 46px，gap: 8px，格子圆角 14px。用 grid-column: span 与 grid-row: span 混排 1×1、2×1、2×2 三种尺寸，让主图占 2×2、指标和快捷入口占小格，所有边缘对齐同一条列线。窄屏降到 2 列，跨格跟着重算，别留空边。
prompt.en: bento grid layout, CSS grid, grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)), grid-auto-rows: 46px, gap: 8px, tiles with grid-column: span / grid-row: span mixing 1x1 2x1 2x2 sizes, border-radius: 14px, all edges aligned to the same column lines, collapse to 2 columns on mobile

entries.oneLiner: 滚动停下来时自动对齐到某一张卡片，不会卡在半路上。
entries.oneLinerEn: Scrolling comes to rest on a card instead of stopping halfway between two of them.

prompt.zh: 做一个横向滚动的卡片选择器：滚动容器用 scroll-snap-type: x mandatory，子项用 scroll-snap-align: start，容器加 scroll-padding: 12px，子项加 scroll-snap-stop: always，防止一次滑动跳过好几张。容器自身要有固定高度和 overflow-x: auto，让原生惯性和键盘滚动都可用。系统开启「减少动态效果」时 scroll-behavior 用 auto。
prompt.en: horizontal snap slider, scroll container with scroll-snap-type: x mandatory, items with scroll-snap-align: start, scroll-padding: 12px, scroll-snap-stop: always to prevent skipping multiple slides, overflow-x: auto container with fixed height, native momentum scrolling and keyboard support, scroll-behavior: auto under prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 点标题展开内容，同一组里通常只开一个，标题一直在。
entries.oneLinerEn: Clicking a heading reveals its panel, usually one at a time, and the headings never move.

prompt.zh: 做一个折叠面板（accordion）：同一组里同时只展开一项（单开手风琴），展开和收起时长 260ms，缓动 cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)；标题用真正的 <button> 并带 aria-expanded，箭头图标展开时旋转 180°。动画不要碰 height: auto（浏览器不会过渡），用 grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr 配一层 overflow: hidden。系统开启「减少动态效果」时时长设成 0。
prompt.en: accordion disclosure pattern, single-open, only one panel expanded at a time, expand and collapse duration 260ms with easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), header is a real button with aria-expanded and a chevron that rotates 180deg when open, animate grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr inside overflow: hidden instead of height: auto, set duration to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 面板背后的内容被真的模糊掉，像隔着一层磨砂玻璃看过去。
entries.oneLinerEn: A panel blurs the content behind it, like looking through ground glass.

prompt.zh: 做一个毛玻璃（Frosted Glass）面板：用 backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(115%) 把面板背后的内容模糊掉，面板底色 rgba(255,255,255,0.08)，圆角 14px，1px rgba(255,255,255,0.18) 描边勾出玻璃边缘。面板必须叠在有内容的背景上（照片或彩色渐变），不要用半透明纯色糊弄，那不是毛玻璃。
prompt.en: frosted glass panel, backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(115%), -webkit-backdrop-filter fallback, background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08), border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18), border-radius: 14px, must sit over visible content behind

entries.oneLiner: 半透明面板 + 亮边 + 柔影叠在彩色背景上，像一块玻璃浮在画面里。
entries.oneLinerEn: A translucent panel with a bright edge and soft shadow, floating over a colorful background.

prompt.zh: 做一块玻璃拟态（Glassmorphism）卡片：backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(160%)，面板底色 linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.16), rgba(255,255,255,0.06))，1px 描边 rgba(255,255,255,0.30)，外投影 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.30)，再补 inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5) 当顶部高光，圆角 18px。卡片必须压在彩色渐变或照片上，并写 -webkit-backdrop-filter 和够不透明的兜底色。
prompt.en: glassmorphism card, backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(160%), -webkit-backdrop-filter, background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.16), rgba(255,255,255,0.06)), border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.30), box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.30) and inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5), border-radius: 18px, translucent frosted panel over colorful gradient, fallback background for unsupported browsers

entries.oneLiner: 多个径向渐变叠在一起，颜色朝任意方向过渡，没有一条直线的渐变轴。
entries.oneLinerEn: Several radial gradients stacked so color flows in any direction, with no single gradient axis.

prompt.zh: 铺一块渐变网格（Mesh Gradient）背景：用 5 层 radial-gradient(circle at ...) 叠出来，每层色标在 55% 处提前淡出，透明端写成同色的 rgba(...,0)；底色 #101018。整层加 filter: blur(0px) hue-rotate(0deg)，再 scale(1.3) 放大避免模糊露边。让色斑用 18s ease-in-out 无限缓慢缩放旋转，注意 CSS 没有 mesh-gradient 属性，只能这样叠。
prompt.en: mesh gradient background, 5 layered radial-gradient() color blobs, transparent color stops at 55% using rgba(r,g,b,0), base color #101018, filter: blur(0px) hue-rotate(0deg), transform: scale(1.3) to hide blur edges, 18s ease-in-out infinite drift animation, no native mesh-gradient property in CSS

entries.oneLiner: 在画面上撒一层随机像素，给纯色和渐变加质感，顺手压掉色带。
entries.oneLinerEn: A layer of random pixels over the surface that adds texture and hides banding in gradients.

prompt.zh: 给这块深色渐变面板加一层颗粒噪点（grain noise）：把一张 160x160 的 SVG feTurbulence data URI 当 background-image 平铺，baseFrequency="0.67"（约 1.5px 颗粒）、type="fractalNoise"、numOctaves="3"、stitchTiles="stitch"；噪点层 opacity: 10%、mix-blend-mode: overlay、pointer-events: none；再补一个 <feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="0"/> 把噪声转成中性灰（feTurbulence 连 alpha 都是随机的，不转灰叠上去会发彩）。再用 steps() 的 transform 位移做胶片跳动，目的是压住渐变色带，不是把画面搞脏。
prompt.en: film grain noise overlay, SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency="0.67" numOctaves="3" stitchTiles="stitch", data URI background-image repeated 160px tile, opacity: 10%, mix-blend-mode: overlay, pointer-events: none, feColorMatrix saturate 0 to keep the grain neutral, steps(6) transform jitter keyframes, dithering to hide gradient banding

entries.oneLiner: 一块柔光跟着指针在卡片表面移动，像有人拿手电照上去。
entries.oneLinerEn: A soft pool of light that follows the pointer across a card, like a flashlight held to it.

prompt.zh: 做卡片聚光（spotlight glow）：卡片 overflow: hidden，里面放一个 440px 的圆形光斑，背景 radial-gradient(circle, hsla(40, 95%, 70%, 0.22) 0%, hsla(40, 95%, 70%, 0) 70%)，mix-blend-mode: screen，pointer-events: none。用 pointermove 把指针坐标换算成光斑的 transform: translate3d()，直接改元素 style 不要 setState，并加 120ms 的 transform 过渡；指针移出回到卡片中心。默认位置就要好看，因为触屏没有 hover。
prompt.en: spotlight card glow, 440px circle, radial-gradient(circle, hsla(40, 95%, 70%, 0.22), transparent 70%), mix-blend-mode: screen, pointer-events: none, overflow: hidden, follow cursor with pointermove, write transform: translate3d directly to the element (no React state), 120ms ease-out transition on transform, recenter on pointerleave, static fallback for touch devices

entries.oneLiner: 描边不是一种颜色，而是一条渐变沿着元素轮廓走一圈。
entries.oneLinerEn: The border is not one color but a gradient running once around the element outline.

prompt.zh: 给卡片做渐变描边（gradient border）：不要用 border-image，它不支持圆角。写成 border: 2px solid transparent，再叠两层背景——padding-box 一层实底盖住内部，border-box 一层 linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(14, 82%, 70%), hsl(104, 84%, 64%), hsl(194, 80%, 68%))，配 border-radius: 14px。再用 @property 注册一个角度变量，让描边 6s 线性无限慢慢转。
prompt.en: gradient border, border: 2px solid transparent, background: linear-gradient(...) padding-box, linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(14, 82%, 70%), hsl(104, 84%, 64%), hsl(194, 80%, 68%)) border-box, background-clip: padding-box / border-box, border-radius: 14px, @property registered angle, 6s linear infinite rotation, avoid border-image since it ignores border-radius

entries.oneLiner: 字号随容器宽度连续变化，不会在断点上突然跳一档。
entries.oneLinerEn: Font size scales continuously with the container width, so it never jumps a step at a breakpoint.

prompt.zh: 做一个流体排版（fluid type）的标题，font-size 写成 clamp(16px, calc(16px + 3cqw), 44px)，随容器宽度连续变化，不要用媒体查询断点。父容器加 container-type: inline-size，让 cqw 跟卡片宽度而不是视口走。行高用无单位倍数，保证字放大后不挤。
prompt.en: fluid type scale, font-size: clamp(16px, calc(16px + 3cqw), 44px), container-type: inline-size, cqw container query units, no media query breakpoints, unitless line-height, responsive typography

entries.oneLiner: 多行标题的每行长度被拉齐，最后一行不再只剩一个孤字。
entries.oneLinerEn: Line lengths in a multi-line heading are evened out, so the last line no longer holds one orphaned word.

prompt.zh: 把这段英文标题的容器宽度限制在 16ch，然后给文本加上 text-wrap: balance。它会把每行长度拉平，消除最后一行只有一个词的孤行，注意只用在六行以内的短文本上。
prompt.en: text-wrap: balance, max-width: 16ch, headline line balancing, avoid orphan/widow, only for short text (Chromium caps balance at 6 lines), graceful fallback, no manual br

entries.oneLiner: 把文字当成蒙版，露出来的不是单色而是背后的渐变。
entries.oneLinerEn: The text acts as a mask, so what shows through is the gradient behind it instead of a single color.

prompt.zh: 做一个渐变文字（gradient text）标题：background-image 用 linear-gradient(120deg, 首色停在 0%，#c9382a → #b8721c)，再写 background-clip: text 和 color: transparent，Safari 补 -webkit-background-clip: text。记得给 forced-colors 模式退回实色，保证高对比度下文字不会消失。
prompt.en: gradient text, background-image: linear-gradient(120deg, #c9382a → #b8721c), background-clip: text, -webkit-background-clip: text, color: transparent, -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent, forced-colors fallback, contrast at least 4.5:1

entries.oneLiner: 标题里的字一个接一个落到位，像被逐字写出来。
entries.oneLinerEn: The characters of a headline drop into place one after another, as if written out letter by letter.

prompt.zh: 做一个逐字显现（character reveal）的标题：把「把一句话拆成字再依次落位」按字拆成 span，每个字从下方 14px、opacity 0 进入原位，单字时长 480ms，缓动 cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)，相邻两字间隔 45ms，12 个字总时长约 975ms。只用 transform 和 opacity 实现；给可视文字加 aria-hidden，另放一份完整文本给读屏；系统开启减少动态效果时整句一次显示。
prompt.en: character reveal, split text into per-character spans, each char animates opacity 0 to 1 and translateY(14px) to 0, duration 480ms, per-char delay 45ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), animate transform/opacity only, aria-hidden on visual text plus sr-only copy, respect prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 一个字体文件里带着连续的字重轴，可以停在任意粗细。
entries.oneLinerEn: A single font file carries a continuous weight axis, so it can stop at any weight.

prompt.zh: 用可变字体（variable font）做一个字重可调的文字块，字体是 Space Grotesk，轴范围大约 300–700。font-variation-settings 写成 "wght" 450，字重取连续值，任意数字都要真正插值，不是就近跳到某一档。旁边放一行 300–700 的对照尺。给不支持可变字体的浏览器留一个接近的静态字重兜底。
prompt.en: variable font, font-variation-settings: "wght" 450, continuous weight interpolation, wght axis, @font-face font-weight range, font-display: swap fallback, weight ruler 300-700, respect prefers-reduced-motion

entries.oneLiner: 数字从 0 快速滚到目标值，然后停住。
entries.oneLinerEn: A number races from 0 up to its target value and then holds still.

prompt.zh: 做一个数字滚动（count up）：数字在 1200ms 内用 easeOutExpo 缓动从 0 滚到 12800，每三位加千分位，用 requestAnimationFrame 按时间戳算进度，不要用 setInterval。容器用 font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums 并预留宽度，避免位数变化时抖动；系统开启减少动态效果时直接显示 12800。
prompt.en: count up animation, animate number from 0 to 12800 in 1200ms with easeOutExpo easing, requestAnimationFrame with timestamp-based progress, font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, thousands separator, reserve width to avoid layout shift, respect prefers-reduced-motion (render final value)
